gen-megrim-gf-ruda: Thin, angular and a bit sci-fi, Megrim draws every stroke to one measured thickness. And Ruda handles the reading, with a sizable x-height and wide-mouthed rounds that stay friendly on a screen.
gen-megrim-gf-saira: Megrim is angular and futuristic, its tube-like strokes holding their thickness through every bend, while Saira stays quietly in the background. Their strongest quality is that tension between sharp and smooth.
gen-megrim-gf-sarpanch: Sharp-cornered and a touch futuristic, Megrim has no thick-thin pulse in any stroke. But Sarpanch is the real strength here: its clearly open e and compact ascender gap make the lines easy to follow.
gen-megrim-gf-savate: Megrim goes first, all angles and measured hairline strokes. Savate follows in a plain sans with open curves and a tall rounded o, so the page gets a crisp futuristic headline and a text face that barely draws attention to itself.
gen-megrim-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk reads big and open, with tall-bowled e and a. Its strongest quality is how much friendlier it feels beside Megrim, whose angular strokes all carry the same visual weight.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-tiktok-sans: Expressive and slightly odd, Tektur has pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase that grab attention at once. TikTok Sans does the quieter job, its tall x-height and spacious c keeping longer lines comfortable.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-vend-sans: Commanding, Tilt Neon pours out tube-like strokes with a splayed c terminal. Vend Sans then reads like a ruler-drawn line, its tall x-height and wide, unclosed curves keeping a plain sans text smooth over many lines.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans has big lowercase eyes and tubular strokes, like bent copper pipe, with curves left pleasantly unfinished. Shrink Unica One down and its commanding presence thins out fast.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sen: Distinctive from the first word, Gugi has tall lowercase and open terminals that make headlines feel bold and shaped. Sen takes the quieter job, its constant-weight line and tall lowercase tracing each letter smoothly.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sofia-sa: Love Ya Like A Sister has stubby ascenders and a level, accent-free beat. Sofia Sans stands tall beside it as a plain sans with no thick-thin modulation, giving the page an upright, steady counterpoint.
